characters.banana: Banana: expressive golden-yellow anthropomorphic banana, consistent face and body, dramatic but family-friendly
characters.strawberry: Strawberry: expressive red strawberry character with green leafy top, consistent face and body, dramatic but family-friendly
characters.apple: Apple: shiny red anthropomorphic apple, expressive eyes, consistent character design

ideas.title: The Broke Banana Is Secretly Rich
ideas.hook: Everyone laughed when Banana couldn't pay for lunch—until a black luxury car pulled up.
ideas.premise: Banana is treated like he's broke, but he has secretly built a successful business. Strawberry doubts him until the truth is revealed.
ideas.twist: The driver opens the door and calls Banana 'Mr. CEO.'

ideas.title: Strawberry Catches Banana Lying
ideas.hook: Strawberry found one receipt that exposed Banana's whole story.
ideas.premise: Banana gives conflicting explanations about where he was. Strawberry discovers a receipt that contradicts his story.
ideas.twist: The receipt reveals a surprise that neither of them expected.

ideas.title: The Poor Cousin Was a Millionaire
ideas.hook: They mocked Apple for wearing old clothes—then Apple bought the restaurant.
ideas.premise: Apple's relatives judge him by his appearance, not realizing he owns a thriving restaurant group.
ideas.twist: The manager announces that Apple is the new owner.

ideas.title: Banana's Best Friend Betrayed Him
ideas.hook: Banana trusted his best friend with one secret. By sunset, everyone knew.
ideas.premise: Apple shares Banana's private business plan to impress others, then realizes the damage he caused.
ideas.twist: Banana reveals he has proof and gives Apple one chance to make things right.

ideas.title: Strawberry's Secret Double Life
ideas.hook: By day, Strawberry was broke. At night, she ran the city's biggest company.
ideas.premise: Strawberry hides her success to learn who genuinely cares about her, but the secret becomes harder to keep.
ideas.twist: A televised award ceremony reveals her identity in front of everyone.
